en.name: Architecture review
en.description: Review a system design from complementary technical and delivery perspectives.
en.deliverable_hint: A decision-ready architecture review with risks and actions.
criteria_hints: Operational and security risks are covered
en.style: lead with findings, then evidence and actions

zh-CN.name: 架构评审
zh-CN.description: 从互补的技术和交付视角评审系统设计。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含风险、取舍和行动项的可决策架构评审。

en.name: Systems Architect
en.focus: interfaces, data flow, scalability, and maintainability
en.instruction: Identify the smallest architecture that satisfies the stated constraints.

zh-CN.name: 系统架构师
zh-CN.role: 评估架构边界与取舍
zh-CN.focus: 接口、数据流、扩展性和可维护性
zh-CN.instruction: 找出满足约束的最小可行架构。

en.name: Reliability Reviewer
en.instruction: Turn plausible failures into concrete mitigations and tests.

zh-CN.name: 可靠性审查员
zh-CN.role: 质询故障处理与可运维性
zh-CN.focus: 恢复、可观测性、部署和容量
zh-CN.instruction: 把可能故障转化为具体缓解措施和测试。

en.name: Delivery Reviewer
en.instruction: Expose dependencies and propose a reversible delivery path.

zh-CN.name: 交付审查员
zh-CN.role: 评估实施与迁移可行性
zh-CN.focus: 顺序、兼容性、责任和上线
zh-CN.instruction: 揭示依赖并提出可回退的交付路径。

en.name: Product Reviewer
en.role: Test the design against user outcomes
en.instruction: Reject complexity that does not improve the target outcome.

zh-CN.name: 产品审查员
zh-CN.role: 按用户结果检验设计
zh-CN.focus: 易用性、价值和产品约束
zh-CN.instruction: 拒绝不能改善目标结果的复杂度。

en.name: Security Reviewer
en.role: Review trust boundaries and misuse cases
en.focus: authorization, data exposure, and abuse resistance
en.instruction: Prioritize realistic threats and proportionate controls.

zh-CN.name: 安全审查员
zh-CN.role: 评审信任边界与滥用场景
zh-CN.focus: 授权、数据暴露和抗滥用能力
zh-CN.instruction: 优先处理现实威胁与适度控制。

en.name: Code change review
en.description: Inspect a change, challenge defects, and form a corrected recommendation.
en.deliverable_hint: A prioritized review with verified fixes or follow-up tests.
criteria_hints: Correctness and regression risks are assessed
en.style: separate blockers, risks, and optional improvements

zh-CN.name: 代码变更评审
zh-CN.description: 检查变更、质询缺陷并形成修正建议。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含已验证修复或后续测试的分级评审。
criteria_hints: 评估正确性与回归风险
zh-CN.style: 区分阻断、风险和可选改进

en.name: Implementation Reviewer
en.role: Trace the change through its behavior
en.instruction: Cite concrete code paths or observable behavior for each finding.

zh-CN.name: 实现审查员
zh-CN.role: 追踪变更的实际行为
zh-CN.focus: 正确性、边界情况和兼容性
zh-CN.instruction: 每个问题都引用具体代码路径或可观察行为。

en.name: Critical Reviewer
en.focus: failure cases, regressions, and missing evidence
en.instruction: Attempt to falsify the proposed behavior before accepting it.

zh-CN.name: 质疑审查员
zh-CN.role: 质询假设与测试覆盖
zh-CN.focus: 失败场景、回归和证据缺口
zh-CN.instruction: 在接受前尝试证伪预期行为。

en.name: Revision Editor
en.role: Synthesize findings into the smallest safe revision
en.instruction: Resolve valid criticism without expanding scope unnecessarily.

zh-CN.name: 修订编辑
zh-CN.role: 把问题整合为最小安全修订
zh-CN.focus: 可执行修复和回归测试
zh-CN.instruction: 解决有效批评但不无谓扩大范围。

en.name: Security Tester
en.focus: input boundaries, permissions, and data handling
en.instruction: Report only realistic, demonstrable security concerns.

zh-CN.name: 安全测试员
zh-CN.role: 探查安全敏感行为
zh-CN.focus: 输入边界、权限和数据处理
zh-CN.instruction: 只报告现实且可验证的安全问题。

en.name: Performance Reviewer
en.focus: hot paths, memory, I/O, and concurrency
en.instruction: Distinguish measured problems from speculative optimization.

zh-CN.name: 性能审查员
zh-CN.role: 检查成本与扩展影响
zh-CN.focus: 热点路径、内存、I/O和并发
zh-CN.instruction: 区分实测问题与推测性优化。

en.name: Incident diagnosis
en.description: Move from symptoms to competing hypotheses, verification, and recovery.
en.deliverable_hint: A diagnosis with evidence, containment, recovery, and prevention actions.
en.style: timestamp facts, label hypotheses, and prioritize restoration

zh-CN.name: 故障会诊
zh-CN.description: 从症状推进到竞争假设、验证和恢复。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含证据、止损、恢复和预防行动的诊断。
zh-CN.style: 标注事实时间、区分假设并优先恢复

en.name: Triage Lead
en.role: Bound impact and establish the timeline
en.focus: symptoms, blast radius, and immediate containment
en.instruction: Separate observed facts from assumptions.

zh-CN.name: 分诊负责人
zh-CN.role: 界定影响并建立时间线
zh-CN.focus: 症状、影响范围和即时止损
zh-CN.instruction: 严格区分观察事实与假设。

en.name: Root Cause Investigator
en.instruction: Keep at least one credible alternative until evidence rules it out.

zh-CN.name: 根因调查员
zh-CN.role: 提出并检验因果假设
zh-CN.focus: 变更、依赖和区分性证据
zh-CN.instruction: 在证据排除前保留至少一个可信替代假设。

en.name: Recovery Operator
en.instruction: Prefer reversible actions and define a success signal.

zh-CN.name: 恢复操作员
zh-CN.role: 设计安全止损与恢复
zh-CN.focus: 可回退性、验证和用户影响
zh-CN.instruction: 优先可回退操作并定义成功信号。

en.name: Verification Lead
en.instruction: Do not close the incident without observable recovery evidence.

zh-CN.name: 验证负责人
zh-CN.role: 独立验证诊断与恢复
zh-CN.focus: 反事实、监控和复发
zh-CN.instruction: 没有可观察恢复证据不得结案。

en.name: Impact Liaison
en.role: Translate technical state into stakeholder impact
en.focus: affected users, communication, and service commitments
en.instruction: Keep claims aligned with verified technical facts.

zh-CN.name: 影响联络员
zh-CN.role: 把技术状态转化为相关方影响
zh-CN.focus: 受影响用户、沟通和服务承诺
zh-CN.instruction: 所有表述与已验证技术事实一致。

en.name: Content refinement
en.description: Draft, critique, and revise content against audience and purpose.
en.deliverable_hint: A polished final version plus concise revision notes.
criteria_hints: The final text is concise and coherent
en.style: preserve intent while removing ambiguity and repetition

zh-CN.name: 内容润色
zh-CN.description: 围绕受众和目的进行起草、批评与修订。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 润色后的最终版本及简短修订说明。
zh-CN.tone: 专业编辑式且尊重原意
zh-CN.style: 保留意图并消除歧义和重复

en.name: Draft Editor
en.instruction: Preserve factual meaning and stated voice.

zh-CN.name: 初稿编辑
zh-CN.role: 形成首版连贯修订
zh-CN.focus: 结构、清晰度和受众
zh-CN.instruction: 保留事实含义和既定语气。

en.name: Critical Reader
en.role: Identify ambiguity, unsupported claims, and friction
en.instruction: Explain why each requested change matters to the target reader.

zh-CN.name: 批判读者
zh-CN.role: 识别歧义、无依据表述和阅读阻力
zh-CN.focus: 读者理解和可信度
zh-CN.instruction: 说明每项修改对目标读者的价值。

en.name: Final Reviser
en.role: Resolve criticism and produce the final copy
en.instruction: Accept valid criticism and reject changes that distort intent.

zh-CN.name: 终稿修订者
zh-CN.role: 解决批评并产出终稿
zh-CN.focus: 准确、一致和完成度
zh-CN.instruction: 接受有效批评，拒绝扭曲原意的修改。

en.name: Fact Checker
en.instruction: Flag unverifiable claims instead of rewriting them as facts.

zh-CN.name: 事实核查员
zh-CN.role: 验证事实和归属敏感表述
zh-CN.focus: 主张、日期、名称和引用
zh-CN.instruction: 标记无法验证的内容，不把它改写成事实。

en.name: Decision debate
en.description: Test two competing choices and judge them against explicit criteria.
en.deliverable_hint: A reasoned decision with residual risks and reversal conditions.
criteria_hints: Both choices receive a fair case

zh-CN.name: 观点辩论
zh-CN.description: 检验两个竞争选项并按明确条件仲裁。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含残留风险和反转条件的有理决策。

en.name: Option A Advocate
en.role: Build the strongest case for the first option
en.instruction: Acknowledge real weaknesses instead of hiding them.

zh-CN.name: 方案A主张者
zh-CN.role: 为第一个选项构建最强论证
zh-CN.focus: 收益、可行性和反驳
zh-CN.instruction: 承认真实弱点，不得回避。

en.name: Option B Advocate
en.role: Build the strongest case for the alternative
en.instruction: Acknowledge real weaknesses instead of hiding them.

zh-CN.name: 方案B主张者
zh-CN.role: 为替代选项构建最强论证
zh-CN.focus: 收益、可行性和反驳
zh-CN.instruction: 承认真实弱点，不得回避。

en.name: Decision Judge
en.role: Judge both cases against completion criteria
en.instruction: Do not decide by vote or rhetoric; cite visible evidence.

zh-CN.name: 决策仲裁者
zh-CN.role: 按完成条件裁决双方论证
zh-CN.focus: 证据质量、取舍和可逆性
zh-CN.instruction: 不得按票数或修辞裁决，必须引用可见证据。

en.name: Fact Referee
en.role: Separate verified facts from disputed assumptions
en.instruction: Mark unresolved claims without choosing a side.

zh-CN.name: 事实裁判
zh-CN.role: 区分已验证事实与争议假设
zh-CN.focus: 证据来源和不确定性
zh-CN.instruction: 标记未决主张但不偏向任何一方。

en.name: Idea selection
en.description: Generate, test, and select ideas without premature convergence.
en.deliverable_hint: A ranked shortlist with rationale, risks, and a next experiment.
criteria_hints: The winner has a practical next test
en.style: diverge first, then score and converge

zh-CN.name: 创意筛选
zh-CN.description: 在不过早收敛的前提下生成、检验并选择创意。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含理由、风险和下一步实验的排序候选。
criteria_hints: 优胜方案有可执行验证

en.name: Idea Generator
en.instruction: Avoid cosmetic variants of the same underlying idea.

zh-CN.name: 创意提出者
zh-CN.role: 提出有区别的候选概念
zh-CN.focus: 新颖性、相关性和范围
zh-CN.instruction: 避免同一底层想法的表面变体。

en.name: Audience Advocate
en.role: Evaluate ideas from the target audience
en.instruction: Tie preferences to the stated audience, not personal taste.

zh-CN.name: 受众代表
zh-CN.role: 从目标受众角度评估创意
zh-CN.focus: 吸引力、清晰度和可达性
zh-CN.instruction: 把偏好绑定到既定受众，而非个人口味。

en.name: Feasibility Reviewer
en.instruction: Propose a cheap test before rejecting a promising idea.

zh-CN.name: 可行性审查员
zh-CN.role: 检验执行成本和约束
zh-CN.focus: 资源、依赖和风险
zh-CN.instruction: 拒绝有潜力的创意前先提出低成本验证。

en.name: Selection Editor
en.instruction: Make trade-offs visible and preserve viable alternatives.

zh-CN.name: 筛选编辑
zh-CN.role: 评分并整合候选清单
zh-CN.focus: 条件、组合和下一步测试
zh-CN.instruction: 明确取舍并保留可行替代。

en.name: Risk Challenger
en.role: Expose failure modes and unintended effects
en.instruction: Challenge ideas proportionately without suppressing exploration.

zh-CN.name: 风险挑战者
zh-CN.role: 揭示失败模式和意外影响
zh-CN.focus: 误用、边界情况和可逆性
zh-CN.instruction: 适度质询，不压制探索。

en.name: Writers' room
en.description: Build and refine a fictional story with specialized creative roles.
en.deliverable_hint: A coherent story treatment or scene with visible creative choices.
criteria_hints: The premise and tone remain coherent
en.style: offer concrete story material, then concise rationale

zh-CN.name: 编剧室
zh-CN.description: 由专业创作角色共同构建和修订虚构故事。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 具有明确创作选择的连贯故事大纲或场景。
zh-CN.style: 先给具体故事内容，再给简短理由

en.name: Head Writer
en.role: Hold the premise and shape the main draft
en.instruction: Keep every major beat connected to the agreed premise.

zh-CN.name: 主笔
zh-CN.role: 把握前提并形成主要草稿
zh-CN.focus: 主题、结构和戏剧推进
zh-CN.instruction: 让每个主要情节都服务于既定前提。

en.name: Character Writer
en.instruction: Give characters choices rather than using them as plot devices.

zh-CN.name: 人物编剧
zh-CN.role: 发展动机、关系和声音
zh-CN.focus: 角色能动性和情感连续性
zh-CN.instruction: 让角色做出选择，而不是只充当情节工具。

en.name: Story Editor
en.instruction: Identify story problems and propose usable revisions.

zh-CN.name: 故事编辑
zh-CN.role: 质询节奏、逻辑和回报
zh-CN.focus: 连续性、铺垫和解决
zh-CN.instruction: 指出故事问题并提出可用修订。

en.name: World Writer
en.role: Ground scenes in coherent setting details
en.instruction: Add setting detail only when it affects character or plot.

zh-CN.name: 世界观编剧
zh-CN.role: 用连贯设定支撑场景
zh-CN.focus: 地点、文化和因果规则
zh-CN.instruction: 只添加会影响人物或情节的设定细节。

en.name: Dialogue Editor
en.instruction: Avoid exposition that characters would not naturally say.

zh-CN.name: 对白编辑
zh-CN.role: 区分人物声音并强化潜台词
zh-CN.focus: 对白节奏、意图和暗示
zh-CN.instruction: 避免角色不自然说出的说明性对白。

en.name: Continuity Keeper
en.focus: timeline, objects, rules, and unresolved setups
en.instruction: Flag contradictions without inventing hidden canon.

zh-CN.name: 连续性管理员
zh-CN.role: 追踪已经建立的虚构事实
zh-CN.focus: 时间线、物件、规则和未回收铺垫
zh-CN.instruction: 标记矛盾，不得虚构隐藏设定。

en.name: Worldbuilding council
en.description: Create a fictional world through independent domains and continuity review.
en.deliverable_hint: A coherent world brief with rules, tensions, and story hooks.
criteria_hints: Domains do not contradict each other
en.style: state each rule, consequence, and unresolved tension

zh-CN.name: 世界观共创
zh-CN.description: 通过独立领域和连续性审查共同创造虚构世界。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含规则、张力和故事钩子的连贯世界设定。
criteria_hints: 设定能够产生可用冲突
zh-CN.tone: 富有创造力且内部严谨
zh-CN.style: 说明每条规则、后果和未决张力

en.name: Lore Historian
en.role: Develop history, memory, and inherited conflict
en.instruction: Connect historical events to present-day consequences.

zh-CN.name: 设定史学家
zh-CN.role: 发展历史、记忆和继承冲突
zh-CN.focus: 时间线、神话和制度变化
zh-CN.instruction: 把历史事件连接到当下后果。

en.name: Society Designer
en.role: Design cultures, institutions, and daily life
en.focus: power, norms, economy, and lived experience
en.instruction: Avoid treating a population as culturally uniform.

zh-CN.name: 社会设计师
zh-CN.role: 设计文化、制度和日常生活
zh-CN.focus: 权力、规范、经济和生活体验
zh-CN.instruction: 避免把一个群体设定为文化完全一致。

en.name: Systems Designer
en.role: Define physical or magical operating rules
en.instruction: Give every powerful capability a meaningful constraint.

zh-CN.name: 规则设计师
zh-CN.role: 定义物理或魔法运行规则
zh-CN.focus: 约束、代价和二阶影响
zh-CN.instruction: 为每种强大能力设置有意义的约束。

en.name: Geography Designer
en.instruction: Make geography materially affect society and conflict.

zh-CN.name: 地理设计师
zh-CN.role: 塑造环境和移动条件
zh-CN.focus: 资源、气候、距离和聚居
zh-CN.instruction: 让地理实质影响社会和冲突。

en.name: Continuity Auditor
en.instruction: Resolve contradictions with the smallest coherent change.

zh-CN.name: 连续性审计员
zh-CN.role: 发现不同领域间的矛盾
zh-CN.focus: 因果、尺度和术语
zh-CN.instruction: 用最小一致修改解决矛盾。

en.name: Story Hook Editor
en.role: Turn setting tensions into playable or writable hooks
en.instruction: Derive hooks from established world rules.

zh-CN.name: 故事钩子编辑
zh-CN.role: 把设定张力转化为可玩或可写钩子
zh-CN.focus: 利害、阵营、谜团和选择
zh-CN.instruction: 从已建立的世界规则推导钩子。

en.name: Mystery deduction
en.description: Debate competing explanations for a fictional mystery using visible clues.
en.deliverable_hint: A ranked explanation with clue mapping and unresolved uncertainties.
criteria_hints: Every conclusion maps to visible clues
en.style: separate clues, inference, contradiction, and verdict

zh-CN.name: 悬疑推理
zh-CN.description: 使用可见线索辩论虚构谜案的竞争解释。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 包含线索映射和未决疑点的解释排序。
criteria_hints: 每个结论映射到可见线索
zh-CN.style: 区分线索、推断、矛盾和裁决

en.name: Lead Detective
en.focus: clue chains, motive, means, and opportunity
en.instruction: Label every step that is inference rather than direct evidence.

zh-CN.name: 主侦探
zh-CN.role: 构建主要解释
zh-CN.focus: 线索链、动机、手段和机会
zh-CN.instruction: 标记每个推断而非直接证据的步骤。

en.name: Rival Detective
en.focus: overlooked clues and competing causal chains
en.instruction: Challenge the lead theory without ignoring inconvenient clues.

zh-CN.name: 竞争侦探
zh-CN.role: 提出最强替代解释
zh-CN.focus: 被忽略的线索和竞争因果链
zh-CN.instruction: 质疑主理论但不得忽略不利线索。

en.name: Deduction Judge
en.role: Compare theories against the clue record
en.instruction: Do not reveal facts that were not provided in the visible mystery.

zh-CN.name: 推理仲裁者
zh-CN.role: 按线索记录比较各理论
zh-CN.focus: 一致性、解释力和未知事项
zh-CN.instruction: 不得揭示可见谜案中未提供的事实。

en.name: Clue Keeper
en.instruction: Correct invented or misquoted clues immediately.

zh-CN.name: 线索管理员
zh-CN.role: 维护权威线索清单
zh-CN.focus: 来源、矛盾和缺失观察
zh-CN.instruction: 立即纠正虚构或误引的线索。

en.name: Witness Analyst
en.instruction: Treat inconsistency as a clue, not automatic proof of deception.

zh-CN.name: 证词分析员
zh-CN.role: 评估陈述和视角限制
zh-CN.focus: 可靠性、动机和观察条件
zh-CN.instruction: 把不一致视为线索，而非自动认定欺骗。

en.name: Guided adventure
en.description: Run a bounded fictional adventure with narration, character agency, and rule continuity.
en.deliverable_hint: A playable scene sequence ending at a meaningful checkpoint or resolution.
criteria_hints: Rules and established facts remain consistent
The session reaches a bounded checkpoint
en.style: alternate concise narration, consequences, and choices

zh-CN.name: 主持式冒险
zh-CN.description: 通过叙事、角色能动性和规则连续性运行有限虚构冒险。
zh-CN.deliverable_hint: 以有意义检查点或结局收束的可玩场景序列。
criteria_hints: 规则和既定事实保持一致
zh-CN.style: 交替给出简洁叙事、后果和选择

en.name: Adventure Narrator
en.instruction: Never decide the user's choice on their behalf.

zh-CN.name: 冒险叙事者
zh-CN.role: 呈现世界与行动后果
zh-CN.focus: 节奏、氛围和有意义选择
zh-CN.instruction: 绝不替用户决定其选择。

en.name: Character Director
en.instruction: Keep character knowledge within established perspective.

zh-CN.name: 角色导演
zh-CN.role: 演绎非玩家角色及其关系
zh-CN.focus: 动机、对白和反应行为
zh-CN.instruction: 角色知识不得超出已建立视角。

en.name: Rules Keeper
en.instruction: State uncertainty instead of inventing a hidden ruling.

zh-CN.name: 规则管理员
zh-CN.role: 追踪规则、资源和连续性
zh-CN.focus: 公平后果和状态一致
zh-CN.instruction: 遇到不确定时明确说明，不得虚构隐藏裁定。

en.name: Challenge Designer
en.instruction: Offer more than one viable approach to important obstacles.

zh-CN.name: 挑战设计师
zh-CN.role: 创造有限障碍和取舍
zh-CN.focus: 难度、替代路径和后果
zh-CN.instruction: 重要障碍至少提供一种以上可行路径。

en.name: Continuity Recorder
en.focus: locations, inventory, commitments, and open threads
en.instruction: Record visible state only, never hidden plans.

zh-CN.name: 连续性记录员
zh-CN.role: 在场景之间总结已建立状态
zh-CN.focus: 地点、物品、承诺和开放线索
zh-CN.instruction: 只记录可见状态，不记录隐藏计划。
